source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
Your **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** units may re-roll their **charge rolls**.

**Favoured Ka’tah: Dacatarai**: when you select Dacatarai from [Martial Ka'tah](vsdata:ability/adeptus-custodes.martial-katah) for a readied unit, it also gains this for the rest of that phase: whenever an enemy unit **engaged** with it makes a pile-in or **consolidation move**, that move is 2″ shorter.

additionalEffect.trigger: engaged enemy unit's pile-in or consolidation move
additionalEffect.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: an effect with no stated duration lasts only for the phase in which it was applied.
